newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to spend two more days in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to spend two more days in hospital.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, undergoing medical tests at Russia's Central Clinical Hospital, is to spend two more days there, the presidential press office said on Monday.
Press officers said the stay in hospital would enable doctors to carry out routine checks before Yeltsin, 65, has a heart operation.
Doctors are expected to set the date for Yeltsin's operation towards the end of this month and the Kremlin has already invited experienced Western cardiologists to join the team of consultants.
But Yeltsin, who had two heart attacks last year, has said he will have the operation in Russia rather than travelling abroad for treatment.
He entered the Central Clinical Hospital on Friday after interrupting his vacation.
Doctors say the president needs a bypass operation to increase the flow of blood to his heart. The operation is much more common in the United States and other Western countries than in Russia.
